title: Late Cancellation Retention on Crestline Companion Fares
content:
**Terms.** When a companion booking on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product is cancelled, the cancellation retention kept from the companion fare refund starts from how the booking was cancelled, read from the most recent trip reinstatement on the certificate (its reinstatement ground and its entry date) and the travel date of the most recent companion booking on the certificate:

1. a voluntary cancellation whose reinstatement date is 7 calendar days or fewer before that travel date carries a retention of 30 percent of the companion fare charge, rounded half up to the cent;
2. a voluntary cancellation whose reinstatement date is more than 7 but no more than 21 calendar days before that travel date carries a flat retention of 40 USD, whatever the companion fare;
3. every other cancellation, including every cancellation Crestline made, carries no retention, and the companion fare is refunded in full.

The companion fare charge is the most recent companion fare charge on the certificate. The days before travel are counted from the reinstatement date to the travel date, the reinstatement date excluded and the travel date included.

## Boundaries

| Reinstatement ground | Days from reinstatement date to travel date | Retention |
|---|---|---|
| voluntary cancellation | 0 to 7 | 30 percent of the companion fare charge |
| voluntary cancellation | 8 to 21 | 40 USD flat |
| voluntary cancellation | 22 or more | none |
| Crestline cancellation | any number | none |

## Hypothetical worked cases

- Reinstatement on 3 May, travel date 10 May, voluntary: 7 days (4 May to 10 May), so the retention is 30 percent of a 119.00 USD companion fare charge, 35.70 USD.
- Reinstatement on 2 May, same travel date, voluntary: 8 days, so the retention is 40 USD flat, the same whether the companion fare charge is 119.00 USD or 399.00 USD.
- Reinstatement on 18 April, same travel date, voluntary: 22 days, so no retention.
- Reinstatement on 9 May on the ground of a Crestline cancellation: no retention.
- Voluntary cancellation 5 days before travel with a companion fare charge of 99.99 USD: 30 percent is 29.997 USD, rounded half up to 30.00 USD.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
